svg.title: Step 4: which records are theirs?
svg.desc: Five records. A support ticket matches the old email, an analytics row matches the email hash and an order record matches the stable user ID, so all three go into the case file. A chat transcript that only shares the same name, and a newsletter entry with a similar but not identical email, are rejected. No exact match, no link: a wrong link would delete someone else's data.
svg.text: A record joins the case only when an exact identifier matches.
No exact match, no link. A wrong link would delete someone else’s data.
